title: Rethinking AI Chat UX Design
excerpt: Four structural flaws keep conversational AI interfaces from delivering on their promise: rigid threading, agent lock-in, unsearchable history and eroded trust after a single hallucination. The answer is a continuous UI with persistent workspaces rather than incrementally smarter chatbots.

slides.headline: Rethinking AI Chat UX Design
slides.standfirst: 5 fundamental design flaws in current conversational UIs.

body.text: Current AI chats force a **new thread** for every single topic change. It's rigid, disrupts your flow, and isolates your ideas.
Start with an image? **You're stuck there.** Switching to code or writing often requires a fresh start, killing your momentum instantly.
Your history becomes a **graveyard** of scattered chats. There is no persistent workspace, only fragmented memories you can't easily search.
One "hallucination" breaks the spell. Users are forced to **double-check everything**, completely negating the efficiency gains of AI.
We need persistent workspaces, not just smarter chatbots.
